events.summary: Greetings, commanders!The day we’ve been waiting for has finally arrived! The Victory Banner demo is now available on Steam. This isn’t the full release yet, but it’s still an important and exciting step on the road to the game’s launch.Today, you’ll step into the role of a brave commander and face the enemy on the battlefield in the summer of 1941. events.title: Victory Banner Demo coming October 12!
events.summary: Hello everyone!I have an update about the Victory Banner Demo. The Demo release was moved a little, and the new release date is October 12.We're making this change because we want the Demo to launch closer to the upcoming Steam Next Fest, where Victory Banner will be taking part (Also we'll use this time to deliver some fixes).I hope you’ll give the Demo a try and join us during the event. Thank you for following the game and supporting Victory Banner!Best regards,Dmitry

events.title: Victory Banner — Discover a New WWII Real-Time Strategy
events.summary: Hello, friends! Victory Banner is a dynamic real-time strategy game featuring direct control of any unit — from infantry soldiers to armored vehicles. The first missions of the game explore key events of the early stage of World War II. Prepare for intense battles, engaging missions, and deeply strategic and tactical gameplay.
